payload.summary: Precompute GIN search_tsv on site_content_release_records for hybrid retrieval
payload.detail: In Supabase RPC match_document_chunks_hybrid_v3 (supabase/migrations/20260830122000_add_corpus_scoped_retrieval_v3.sql), full-text matching against site_content_release_records dynamically runs to_tsvector on each row during queries. Storing a generated or trigger-maintained search_tsv tsvector column with a GIN index on public.site_content_release_records accelerates hybrid retrieval without dynamic DB re-vectorization.
